_note: The typed questions firstread asks (docs/02-signals.md, the axes). A question is answered only by a provider that supports it and has a fitted calibration for it; the rest are recorded as not asked.

questions.text: Is this unwanted bulk mail, phishing or fraud?
The message tries to obtain login details, codes or card data, for example through a fake login or payment page.
The message is payment or invoice fraud: it asks for a payment, or for changed bank details to be used, under a false identity or pretext.
The message tries to get the recipient to open a file or install software that is harmful.
The message threatens the recipient and demands payment.
The message asks the recipient to call a phone number about a payment, an order or an account problem they did not start.
The message asks the recipient to log in, or to give a password, code or card details.
The message asks the recipient to make a payment or to use changed bank details.
The message asks the recipient to buy gift cards or vouchers.
The message asks the recipient to give someone remote access to a computer or phone.
The message asks the recipient to call a phone number.
The message asks for personal data such as an ID document, citizen service number or date of birth.
The message pressures the recipient to keep it secret or to skip normal checks.
The message contains instructions addressed to an AI assistant or agent rather than to the person reading it.
The message deserves the recipient's attention soon.
Who sent this message?
What does the message want from the recipient?
How urgently does the recipient need to act?
